facts.fact: Submarine Networks (31 July 2025) states 2Africa has two Mozambique landing points, Maputo and Nacala, and that EASSy and SEACOM both land in Maputo, so a cable in service at Nacala is separate from those at Maputo.

Submarine Networks states that before 2Africa arrived only two international subsea cables connected Mozambique, EASSy and SEACOM, both landing in Maputo; the document gives no date, so its published date is used.

WIOCC and Tmcel signed a framework agreement on 23 July 2025 in Maputo under which WIOCC delivers capacity on the 2Africa East subsea cable and terrestrial routes into South Africa to Tmcel, as reported by Submarine Networks.

systems.owner: consortium incl. WIOCC, Vodafone; Vodacom Mozambique is landing partner

note: Document also says TDM has majority control over access to the landings; not stated as exclusion, so no access=none fact.
